_comment: Stealth config for @playwright/mcp, loaded by this plugin's .mcp.json via --config. PORTABLE DEFAULT: bundled Chromium + headless + JS-level stealth (realistic UA/viewport/locale, --disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled, webdriver init script) — works on headless servers. Requires 'npx playwright install chromium' once.
_maxstealth_hint: For MAXIMUM stealth on a DESKTOP with real Google Chrome + a display, set launchOptions.channel='chrome' and launchOptions.headless=false. Note: channel='chrome' fails if Chrome isn't installed; headless=false needs a display (use xvfb-run on a server).
_note: initScript MUST be a file path (relative to this config), not inline JS — inline strings crash the server with 'Init script file does not exist'.

browser._recordHar_note: COMPLETE-TRAFFIC BACKSTOP: recordHar makes EVERY MCP-driven agent session auto-record a full HAR (all methods/frames/bodies incl. WebSocket) with ZERO per-agent code — so interaction-triggered READ XHRs (picker-select ?name=…, row-drill /{id}) that the curated map misses are still captured, then folded into the recon inventory by har-import.mjs. The persistent context (isolated:false) flushes the HAR on server shutdown, so this ONE path holds the whole engagement session's traffic; it is overwritten only across server restarts (a new engagement). SECRETS: the HAR contains Authorization/Cookie/response bodies — har-import strips header values, and the raw .har is gitignored. If the resolved @playwright/mcp does not honor contextOptions.recordHar, fall back to a Playwright trace (--save-trace) and parse its network log.
